title.en: OWN-BRAND Air 1 compact camera drone, 249 g
short.en: Folding drone under 250 g with a 4K camera and 34 minutes of flight.
description.en: A folding camera drone that weighs 249 g, so in many countries it needs no pilot registration. 4K video at 60 frames per second, up to 34 minutes of flight on one battery, range up to 18 km. Check local rules before flying.
